description: This Dart source file defines the AuthProvider class, a state management class for handling user authentication in a Flutter app. It manages login, social login, and logout functionalities, interacting with an API client and local cache to maintain user session information.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages authentication state, including token management, user information, and login/logout operations.

methods.name: _restore
methods.description: Restores the authentication token from local cache during initialization and updates API client authorization.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates the user with email and password against backend API, stores token on success.

methods.name: socialLogin
methods.description: Authenticates the user using a social provider token (Google, Facebook, Apple) via backend API, then stores the token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the local session, nullifies token and user data, and updates API client.
